//: Recipes (16 §8): what is used up, what tools must be at hand, what know-how it needs, how much work it takes at a rate of 1, and what it gives. Inputs and tools are looked for in the worker's hands and pack, in the station, and in racks and containers within six cells. A recipe `at` a tag is made at a station whose device carries it; one with no `at` is made by hand. Values are illustrative.
name: Herbalism
description: Which plants mend and which kill, and how to make them do it.

name: Bandage
description: Tear a strip of cloth into a bandage.

name: Torch
description: Bind cloth round the head of a stick.

name: Club
description: Cut a log down to a club.

name: Arrows
description: Whittle sticks into shafts and fletch them.

//: Bread at an oven: flour and water, and wood for the fire while it bakes.
name: Bread
description: Knead flour and water and bake it.

//: Salve wants herbalism: of whoever works it, or of a herbal lying on the bench.
name: Healing salve
Nightshade extract
description: Press the berries of nightshade into a vial.

name: Sleeping draught
description: Steep herbs in ale over a fire.

//: Mending: the most damaged blade at hand gets half its strength back.
name: Mend a blade
description: Grind and hone a damaged blade.

//: A still left lit turns ale into a stronger ale by itself, from what is put in it, and wants fuel faster than its boiler gives it.
name: Distil

//: Herbs grow in a bed with water about it, and not otherwise (16 §8.4). It is looked at again every half minute.
name: Grow herbs
